title: Cognition streak
description: UTC-day learning streak from visiting and opening material, optional email reminders. Not Aura and not a payout.
content:
Cognition streak counts showing up to learn. It grows on UTC days you visit or open library material. It is not Aura, not money, and not a ranking of quality.

Primary action: Open Analytics (Learning)

How the streak works

  • A day counts when you visit or open material — not when you give Aura.
  • Days use UTC, not your local calendar.
  • A chip in the app shows the current count. Rules also appear on the Learning analytics tab.

Email reminders

Under Communication settings you can opt in to:

  • Same-day streak reminder
  • Weekly snapshot
  • Streak restart

Hours-before and enable/disable are yours. Defaults stay off until you save them.

What it is not

  • Not an Aura grant. Aura has its own daily budget.
  • Not a paywall unlock.
  • Not a public leaderboard.
